in_sanskrit.name: Kurangi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Black
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kurangi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kura’ meaning ‘black’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often depicted as having a blue-black complexion. Therefore, the name Kurangi is believed to evoke the strength, power, and grace of Lord Shiva.
